name: Post-matric Scholarship Scheme (Other Backward Classes), Uttar Pradesh
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh (centrally assisted)

rules.quote: Students belonging to Other Backward Classes studying in all the government  aided and recognized educational institutes of the state
Native and under study in Uttar Pradesh.
Annual income of parents/guardian of the student is upto Rs. 2 Lakh.

rules.value: Priority order by merit (50% merit first) subject to budget availability
rules.quote: eligible upto the 50 % merit according to the last year examination, subject to availability of the budget
Degree and Master Degree Courses, M. Fil.-Ph.D., Courses of all medical therapies, Technology, Engineering

amount.text: Monthly rates by course group: Group-1 Rs 1200 (hosteller)/Rs 550 (day scholar); Group-2 Rs 820/530; Group-3 Rs 570/300; Group-4 Rs 380/230
amount.quote: Group-3	All graduate level courses which are not included in Group-I and II, like B.A., B. Sc. and B. Com./B.T.C etc. 	570.00	300.00

deadline.text: Online application opens 01 July each year on scholarship.up.gov.in; disbursement 02 October and 26 January
deadline.quote: Process of online application by the students is started with effect from 01 July.
